svg.title: Proposed Rockwood delivery boundary — owner approval required
svg.desc: Gold shows the intersection of Tennessee's Rockwood municipal polygon and Census 37854 ZCTA reference. ZCTA is not a USPS ZIP boundary. Actual eligibility additionally requires a verified address in ZIP 37854. Excluded holes and nearby boundary addresses are not eligible automatically. No boundary is approved or active.

g.text: REVIEW ONLY — NOT APPROVED OR ACTIVE
City limits AND verified ZIP 37854; never all addresses in the ZIP
1 km · north up · roads: Census 2026 reference
37854 ZCTA reference; not exact USPS delivery ZIP limits
Source: Tennessee Comptroller · layer 2 · Rockwood object 269
State data is informational, not a legal survey. Preserve excluded holes.
Display simplified <1 pixel; full geometry used by server. 30 m review margin.
